claim.en: Before the runoff Pellegrini portrayed Korčok as a candidate who would drag Slovakia into war; SME's fact-check noted the president has no power to declare war or involve Slovakia in one.
claim.sk: Pellegrini pred druhým kolom vykresľoval Korčoka ako kandidáta, ktorý bude ťahať Slovensko do vojny; overovanie SME uviedlo, že prezident nemá právomoc vyhlásiť vojnu ani do nej Slovensko zapojiť.

findings.identity: names presidential candidate Peter Pellegrini, chairman of Hlas and Speaker of Parliament
findings.quote: 2. Korčok ťahá Slovensko do vojny "Slovensko nechce prezidenta, ktorý bude Slovensko ťahať do vojny, ale bude hovoriť o mieri. Že chce prezidenta, ktorého slovenské záujmy budú na prvom mieste." Vypnúť reklamu Prezident nemá právomoc svojvoľne vyhlásiť vojnu inému štátu ani možnosť nariadiť, aby sa do nej Slovensko zapojilo.
findings.title: Korčok vs. Pellegrini: Zabudnite na ospalú kampaň. Čo proti sebe hovoria, čo sú fakty a čo pravda?

claim.en: During the campaign it emerged that Pellegrini used a luxury villa owned by Hlas MP Peter Náhlik and flew on Náhlik's private plane; Pellegrini confirmed using the villa.
claim.sk: Počas kampane vyšlo najavo, že Pellegrini využíva luxusnú vilu poslanca Hlasu Petra Náhlika a letel jeho súkromným lietadlom; používanie vily potvrdil.

findings.identity: names presidential candidate and Hlas leader Peter Pellegrini
findings.quote: It was also reported that Hlas MP Peter Náhlik owns a luxury house in Bratislava-Vrakuňa. On Tuesday night, in TV Markíza's televised debate, Pellegrini confirmed that he sometimes uses the villa. Pellegrini also used a private plane owned by the lawmaker to travel to eastern Slovakia last week.
findings.title: News digest: For Pellegrini, Tuesday was a nightmare

claim.en: According to SME, Pellegrini skipped a Radio Expres debate claiming he would be meeting people in the regions, yet was found in Bratislava during the debate.
claim.sk: Podľa SME sa Pellegrini nezúčastnil debaty Rádia Expres s tým, že bude medzi ľuďmi v regiónoch, no počas debaty ho videli v Bratislave.

findings.identity: names presidential candidate and Hlas leader Peter Pellegrini
findings.quote: Presidential candidate and Hlas party leader Peter Pellegrini was supposed to participate in a Tuesday debate hosted by Radio Expres. He declined the offer last weekend, claiming that he would be meeting people in the region. Nonetheless, the Sme daily discovered him in Bratislava at midday on Tuesday, during which the debate, albeit without Pellegrini, took place.
findings.title: News digest: For Pellegrini, Tuesday was a nightmare

claim.en: Denník N raised a possible conflict of interest: Pellegrini bought the flat in J&T's Zuckermandel project while, as deputy PM for investments, he defended state tax relief for J&T and HB Reavis projects.
claim.sk: Denník N poukázal na možný konflikt záujmov: Pellegrini kúpil byt v projekte Zuckermandel od J&T, keď ako vicepremiér pre investície obhajoval štátne úľavy pre projekty J&T a HB Reavis.

findings.identity: names Peter Pellegrini, new Prime Minister (Smer), formerly Deputy PM for Investments
findings.quote: Moreover, Pellegrini bought the flat in Zuckermandel when he was Deputy PM for Investments, defended the state relief for “strategic investments” of two developers, J&T and HB Reavis, in Bratislava. So he may have saved dozens of millions of developers’ money on taxes, Dennik N wrote. Zuckermandel is a project by J&T Real Estate.
findings.title: New PM Pellegrini's earnings and expenses do not match

claim.en: According to Denník N, as reported by The Slovak Spectator, Pellegrini bought a luxury Zuckermandel flat in Bratislava but could not clearly show where the money came from; his office cited car sale, savings and family funds.
claim.sk: Podľa Denníka N, ako uviedol The Slovak Spectator, Pellegrini kúpil luxusný byt v Zuckermandli, no nevedel jasne preukázať pôvod peňazí; jeho úrad uviedol predaj auta, úspory a rodinné zdroje.

findings.identity: names Peter Pellegrini, new Prime Minister (Smer)
findings.quote: The new Prime Minister, Peter Pellegrini of the ruling Smer party, recently bought a flat in a luxurious residential complex on the banks of the Danube River, but cannot clearly prove how he procured the necessary funds to finance the purchase.
findings.title: New PM Pellegrini's earnings and expenses do not match

claim.en: Pellegrini, a long-time Smer politician, served as education minister, Speaker of Parliament and Prime Minister.
claim.sk: Pellegrini, dlhoročný politik Smeru, bol ministrom školstva, predsedom parlamentu a predsedom vlády.

findings.identity: profile of Peter Pellegrini, Smer politician from Banská Bystrica
findings.quote: He became education minister, parliament's speaker, and eventually prime minister in the middle of the election term, when posts remained vacant after the departures of his predecessors.
findings.title: Who is Peter Pellegrini

claim.en: Ex-tax chief František Imrecze and businessman Michal Suchoba testified that Pellegrini took a €150,000 bribe for supporting the virtual cash register project; he was not charged.
claim.sk: Exšéf daniarov František Imrecze a podnikateľ Michal Suchoba vypovedali, že Pellegrini mal vziať úplatok 150-tisíc eur za podporu projektu virtuálnej pokladnice; obvinený nebol.

findings.identity: Hlas leader and former PM Peter Pellegrini
findings.quote: Bývalý šéf daniarov František Imrecze a podnikateľ Michal Suchoba vypovedali, že Pellegrini mal vziať úplatok vo výške 150-tisíc eur za politickú podporu projektu virtuálnej pokladnice. Pellegrini v tom čase pôsobil v rezorte financií. V Pellegriniho prípade sa však polícia nikam neposunula.
findings.title: Príbeh Petra Pellegriniho: Stál verne pri Ficovi, neskôr ho chcel vymeniť a napokon s ním možno bude vládnuť
